text: [block] ledgerlock/format.py:36 — `line_hash` is not implemented, but it is the entirety of this story. AD-5 freezes the formula `SHA-256_hex((prev_hash + "|" + canonical_bytes(line_without_hash)).encode("utf-8"))`; nothing in the module produces that. Every AC of this story (AC-STORY-01-03-1..5) and every downstream consumer (STORY-01-05 AC-1, AC-2; STORY-02-01 verifier) cannot function. Why: STORY-01-05 writes `hash == format.line_hash("GENESIS", ...)` into the first line, STORY-02-01 recomputes it during verify, and the on-disk chain (FR-2) is byte-exact per AD-5. A missing `line_hash` means every later story that touches the chain collapses to `AttributeError` / `ImportError`. This is the only deliverable of the story — the title, AC list, dependencies, and AD-5 all point at this one symbol. Fix: Implement `line_hash(prev_hash, line)` in `ledgerlock/format.py` per AD-5: deep-copy `line` (or rebuild a new dict excluding `"hash"` and `"prev_hash"`), compute `canonical_bytes`, concatenate `prev_hash + "|" + canonical_bytes`, hash with `hashlib.sha256(...).hexdigest()`. Then export it (`__all__`).

The 5 ACs of this story (`AC-STORY-01-03-1` returns 64 lowercase hex chars; `AC-STORY-01-03-2` distinct `prev_hash` → distinct digest; `AC-STORY-01-03-3` ignores pre-set `hash`/`prev_hash`; `AC-STORY-01-03-4` deterministic across invocations; `AC-STORY-01-03-5` accepts `prev_hash == "GENESIS"`) have **zero test coverage**. Verified by `grep AC_STORY_01_03 tests/test_format.py` — no matches; file ends at line 70 with only the 6 STORY-01-02 classes. Combined with the missing implementation, every AC is unverified; even if `line_hash` is implemented, the story gate can only mark this attempt a `unit`/`security` pass via exhaustive external evidence, not via test. Fix: add `unittest.TestCase` classes `AC_STORY_01_03_1_*`, `AC_STORY_01_03_2_*`, `AC_STORY_01_03_3_*`, `AC_STORY_01_03_4_*`, `AC_STORY_01_03_5_*` to `tests/test_format.py`. The tests must be `unittest.TestCase` only (AD-11).
